storyline.real: Rosberg wins from pole by 8.3 s. Both Mercedes stop for softs early, Rosberg on lap 10 and Hamilton a lap later. Rosberg stops again on lap 31; Hamilton leads, asks to run to the flag without a second stop, and is brought in on lap 41, rejoining about 12 s behind.
storyline.headline: Hamilton turns the tables on Rosberg at Yas Marina

mastery.label: Beat Rosberg on two stops, as Hamilton made

hidden.label: Beat Rosberg without a single lap of tyre management

eras.briefing: Yas Marina, 2015, the season finale. Rosberg took pole and leads Hamilton by just under three seconds after seven laps, both Mercedes on super-softs, with Räikkönen third. You run Hamilton. Finish ahead of your team-mate.
